text:
Tanya (CS): FYI - NovaOpen onboarding hitting 429s during quickstart. They're using python sdk v0.9.1, ephemeral keys via demo flow. Happens after a handful of concurrent requests. Logs below, can someone triage quickly? cc @Rafael :eyes:
Rafael (SDK): Thanks. Can you paste the request pattern? my first suspicion is preflight/ephemeral token fanout + concurrent client instantiation. 429s from our preflight quota window look similar.
Tanya (CS): paste from their container logs:
```
2024-10-18T09:12:01Z INFO init: starting client
2024-10-18T09:12:01Z DEBUG auth: fetching ephemeral token -> 200 OK
2024-10-18T09:12:01Z DEBUG preflight: /v1/preflight -> 200 (ok)
2024-10-18T09:12:02Z INFO request: send /v1/generate
2024-10-18T09:12:02Z WARN response: 429 Too Many Requests (preflight window)
2024-10-18T09:12:02Z DEBUG auth: refreshing ephemeral token -> 200
2024-10-18T09:12:02Z INFO retry: backoff 200ms
2024-10-18T09:12:03Z WARN response: 429 Too Many Requests (preflight window)
```
Tanya (CS): They report spinning up ~8 parallel worker processes during quickstart.
Ben (Eng): Which region/edge are they hitting? EU? our preflight windows are stricter on edge gateways with short windows.
Tanya (CS): They're in eu-west-1.
Mike (SE): Note: sdk v0.9.1 did an eager preflight per client instance. If their app forks workers without connection reuse, that generates N preflight calls at once.
Rafael (SDK): Ok, actionable: likely cause = ephemeral token refresh + preflight fanout + concurrent instantiation. Quick mitigations:
- Upgrade to sdk v0.9.3 (coalesces preflight and reuses in-process token requests)
- Enable connection reuse (keepalive) in their http client
- Add small randomized jitter to ephemeral refresh and increase backoff cap
Example curl to test single connection:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $EPHEMERAL" -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
```
Rafael (SDK): Also asked ops if we can temporarily bump their preflight window while they test. @infra-bot any quick assist?
infra-bot: Ops note: temporary preflight bump possible. Please request target window and duration. Automated approval requires Eng+CS ack.
Tanya (CS): Requesting: bump preflight to 5 req/s window for account novaopen for 30m while they validate upgrade.
Ben (Eng): I approved and applied a 30m bump for novaopen. Keep monitoring. Long term: recommend upgrade + coalescing.
Tanya (CS): I'll send them an upgrade snippet and a minimal repro that uses a single client instance across workers. Also share release notes for 0.9.3.
Mike (SE): For immediate testing they can set SDK env var REDWOOD_DISABLE_PREFLIGHT=1 to skip preflight (dev only) and verify nominal traffic, but warn about feature opt-out.
Tanya (CS): Update after call: customer upgraded to 0.9.3, enabled connection reuse, and we had the temporary bump. They reported 429s dropped in the next 10 minutes. I'll close if stable. Thanks all :thumbsup:
